about: Pinned vectors of Q_template_instance v0 and Q_template_instances v0 (verity.circuits.partition_object), checked by tests/verity/circuits/test_template_instance.py; written by it with --write.  Programs are descriptor bytes; units are [unit, root node, member, first gate, end gate, inputs, outputs].
cases: the list order is kept: the same units, another digest
a listed composite whose id is an input id is an instance
refused: the readable id is not the descriptor id
